title: Choosing the correct plural demonstrative
summary: Choose among nearby, farther visible, and identifiable plural referents.
objectives: Use nuo for farther jointly visible groups.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: Plural reference still depends on the speaker-listener situation.
English “these,” “those,” and “they” are useful clues but do not replace the Finnish reference contrast.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: Read whether the group is near, farther and visible, or already identifiable.
Then choose one plural form without changing the supplied sentence frame.

examples.english: Those over there are the cars.

commonMistakes: Do not choose nuo only because English says “those.”
Do not use nämä for a group explicitly placed farther away.
Do not replace ne with he unless the referents are people in standard writing.

Correct. Nuo is the plural demonstrative for a situation where the referents are farther away and visible.
“Nämä” is a plural nominative form for referents near the speaker; use “Nuo”, a plural nominative form for farther, jointly visible referents.
“Ne” is a plural nominative form for already identifiable non-human referents; use “Nuo”, a plural nominative form for farther, jointly visible referents.
